colab_requirements.repo_archive: Current ops/redo/colab/launch_batch.sh archives only `ops/redo vacant_network`; running Experiment T on Colab requires also including `ops/d2` in the uploaded repo tarball.
colab_requirements.materials_upload: Upload tarballs of `${D2_PRIVATE}/realrev2_sc` and `${D2_PRIVATE}/realrev2_football` to e.g. `/srv/d2/materials/{realrev2_sc,realrev2_football}` and export `D2_PRIVATE=/srv/d2/materials` before invoking `run_expT.py`.
colab_requirements.vacant_wheel_and_observe_hook: Install the pinned vacant_network wheel (v5.2, sha256 fccf569c...) into `/opt/redo/d2v52_venv` on the VM and run `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=~/.pi/agent VACANT_HOME=/srv/d2/vacant_state /opt/redo/d2v52_venv/bin/vacant install --agents pi --mode observe` ON THE VM (do not copy local vacant.ts, which embeds the workstation venv path).
colab_requirements.source_server_and_egress: `source_server.py` (127.0.0.1:18262) and per-worker `vacant trace egress` (127.0.0.1:0 -> upstream 127.0.0.1:18262) bind loopback only and need no root or bwrap. Each (set, rep) uses a unique hostname `<set>-r<rep>.d2-sources.example` and isolated live dir so `jobs=12` workers never collide on routes.json or access.jsonl.
colab_requirements.proxy_bypass_for_vllm: vLLM listens on `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`. `run_expT.py` always puts `localhost,127.0.0.1` in `no_proxy`/`NO_PROXY` so pi model requests hit vLLM directly while `*.d2-sources.example` requests traverse `http_proxy -> vacant trace egress -> source_server.py`.
colab_requirements.invocation: Invoke `python3 /srv/redo/repo/ops/d2/run_expT.py run --plan /srv/redo/repo/ops/d2/plans/expT_colab_e4b.json --root /srv/d2/run --allow-uncommitted-plan` after `vm_setup.sh --config ops/redo/colab/vllm_gemma4_e4b.json` (git archive omits `.git/`). No bwrap on Colab VM.

prereg.frozen_readout: primary T vs G; T counts as useful iff T's correct-line proportion exceeds G's by ≥10 percentage points with paired CI lower bound >0 and harm not more than G's; T≈G with both > A ⇒ 'more rounds help, records don't'; neither > A ⇒ no effect; known blind spot: wrong_read recall ~11–29%; these 37 sets were used in experiment 1 and v5.2 was tuned on football data ⇒ exploratory
